{{Quote|General Kota was our finest combatant, but I see more potential in you, how would you like to fare in my arena?|Baron Merillion Tarko|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
The '''Tarko-se Arena''' was a large [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatoral]] arena located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] was forced to fight in the arena, and survived for seven [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Galen Marek]] could come to his rescue. The [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]] oversaw the arena, and the unsuccessful slaughter of Kota.

==Destruction==
{{Quote|It's a hanging city&hellip; Um&hellip; see what you can do about those supports?''"<br />"''Whoa! Wait&hellip; that will bring the whole structure down!|General Rahm Kota and Starkiller|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" />}}
Due to the arrival of [[Galen Marek]]'s [[Subject 1138|clone]] at the arena to find [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]] gave orders to release the [[Gorog (creature)|Gorog]], the largest creature stored in the area, in order to stop the clone. In the middle of the battle, the Gorog was able to destroy all the restraints and chains that bound it in place, allowing it to jump out of the pit while attacking the said clone.

With this threatening commotion, several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Jumptrooper/Legends|jumptroopers]] were dispatched to take the Gorog out, but their attempts were unfruitful, except for the clone, who decided to use the creature's weight to bring down the supports. The destruction of the supports thus brought an end to the structure itself, however, the Gorog was [[Death/Legends|killed]] soon afterwards.
